round.title: depth recovery at SOB1's depth-only structure: importance merging, recurrent execution and per-iteration hidden-state distillation

variants.DMR1-M: variant 1, this design (Stage 1 initialization, Stage 3 recovery)

status: PREPARED at $0, READY_FOR_REVIEW: nothing granted, issued or run
question: At SOB1's depth-only structure (the teacher's 16 kept blocks of 36, width, FFN, heads, embedding and head unchanged), does writing each kept block from its whole span of teacher blocks by the alpha (importance-normalized) merge, instead of keeping it as it is, leave more static fluid reasoning after the SAME Stage-3 recovery?
decided_by: the maintainer's brief of 2026-11-26 (variant 1: the alpha formula, M-act's slot granularity, alignment, importance, RMSNorm handling and all-zero fallback; no beta addition, no learnable coefficients, no fitting; each merged block executed once)

teacher.lineage: the hybrid Qwen3-4B, NOT Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (AGENTS.md P17.1): selection, calibration, statistics, training data, the online KD teacher, tokenizer, chat template and configuration all derive from this one checkpoint

baseline.what: SOB1's depth-only arm: its TRAINING-PRE initialization is this variant's base and its two recovered seeds and their sealed eval-set-1 sets are the direct control (reused, never retrained or regenerated)

mapping.rule: the depth selection is SOB1's, unchanged: no depth search is run again

baseline.tensor_digests: configs/stages/stage-1/depth_merge/depth_init_tensor_digests.json (merge.py digests: every tensor of the base's model.safetensors; the build checks every tensor outside the merged blocks against them bit for bit)

control_sessions.secured_evidence: ~/aad-artifacts/stage1_single_operator_budget/sob1_train_depth_only_20261122_223829/store/out (the dev box; the relay's phase2_evidence archive holds the same bytes)

baseline.not_the_control: RI-LM1 (merges at RI-S1's 28-block structure, untrained) is history: another structure, no recovery; its negative result does not stand in for this comparison

merge.method: alpha_importance_merge: RI-LM1's M-act, at THIS structure's spans
merge.formula: for each kept block j with span S_j (j and the removed blocks after it): theta~_j = sum_{i in S_j} alpha_{j,i} A_{j<-i}(theta_i), alpha_{j,i} = I_{j,i} / sum_{k in S_j} I_{j,k}, per parameter slot

spans.rule: layer_merge.spans_from_kept_blocks(36, kept_blocks): each removed block joins the nearest kept block before it; a run of removed blocks joins as a whole and is merged in one step
spans.unchanged: the 7 blocks whose span is themselves, the embedding, the final norm and the tied head: the base's, bit for bit (their tensors are checked against the base's per-tensor digests)

slots.ffn: per FFN neuron (gate row, up row, down column together): I = E|a| x ||down column||_2 (ffn.activation_importance_v0's statistic)
slots.query_head: per query head (its q rows and o_proj columns): I = mean_t ||W_o,h a_h(t)||^2, its residual write energy (attention.activation_importance_v1's statistic)
slots.kv_group: per KV group (its k / v rows): the summed energy of its query heads
slots.block: q_norm, k_norm and the (folded, unit) norm gains: each block's share of the span's total head energy

merge.alignment: each absorbed block onto the span's kept block, before weighting: FFN neurons by the exact linear assignment on the Pearson correlation of the gated-product features; KV groups by the assignment on the cosine of the groups' summed writes; within each matched group the query heads by the heads' write cosine; head dimensions never move
merge.rmsnorm: each span block's input_layernorm gain folded into its q/k/v input columns and post_attention_layernorm gain into its gate/up input columns (W (g * x) = (W diag g) x), the merged block's two gains then 1; q_norm and k_norm act after the projection and are combined by the block weights
merge.zero_fallback: a slot whose importance is 0 in every block of its span takes uniform weights 1/|S_j|; the count of such slots is recorded
merge.execution: each merged block is executed ONCE (16 blocks, 16 logical layers): the structure, its parameter count (2,003,851,776) and its config file are the base's
merge.role_of_alpha: alpha builds the initial weights only; recovery then trains every trainable parameter as in the base's recipe

not_registered.beta_addition: the original-weights-plus-differences addition (LaCo) is not a candidate here
not_registered.fitting: no initialization fitting, least-squares refit or extra training

merge.what_it_is_not: the weights are convex per slot; that guarantees neither the merged block's output scale nor that it reproduces the teacher span's cumulative update. Neither is claimed; the residual-update diagnostics measure both (diagnostic only)

code.core: aadistill.initialization.planning.layer_merge (fold, permute, assignment, moments, convex weights, merge)
code.instance: scripts/stages/stage-1/reasoning_inheritance/layer_merge.py (RI-LM1's collect_statistics, alignments, statistics_tensors, merged_tensors 'M-act', build_candidate, equivalence_checks, diagnostics), called with THIS design's spans, kept blocks and base digests by scripts/stages/stage-1/depth_merge/merge.py
code.identity: the build records RI-LM1's statistics_code() and candidate_code() identities (ast digests); a persisted product is reused only under the same identity

statistics.session: the packed search's own session (packed_full_search.build_session(which='v3'), as SOB1 phase 1 and RI-LM1 built it: profiles, the packed forward context, the position policy), whose operator config hashes the build checks against the journal before anything runs (teacher_parent_initialization.init_driver.contract)

expected.source: RI-LM1's statistics pass measured 79 packed sequences and 231,242 statistics positions on this profile under the same session (both RI-S1's and TPI1's sessions are packed_full_search.build_session(which='v3'): one session); the build stops on any other count

statistics.where: each block's statistics on its OWN input in the teacher's forward, for the 29 blocks of the 9 merged spans (9 kept + 20 absorbed): 20 (kept, absorbed) pairs
statistics.memory: 20 FFN pairs x 9,728^2 float64 Pearson cross moments = 15.1 GB beside the 8 GB teacher (L40S)
statistics.persisted: records/merge_statistics.safetensors (per block E|a| and head energies; per pair the three permutations) and records/merge_statistics.json; each pair's permutations are written the moment they are computed, with the sha256 of the correlation they came from (a later attempt recomputes the one-pass statistics and reuses a pair only when its correlation hashes the same)
statistics.assignment_time: RI-LM1 measured 1,420 s for 8 assignments on the pod's CPU (178 s each): 20 here, about 1 h

SOB1's depth selection and base initialization (rebuilt from the teacher by frozen_mapping.keep_blocks and checked against the base's tensor digests)
SOB1's depth recovery recipe, plan and its two recovered seeds and sealed sets as the control
recomputed: the statistics of the 29 blocks and the 20 pairs at THIS structure's spans

lineage.rule: one teacher lineage (AGENTS.md P17.1): the original hybrid Qwen3-4B for calibration, statistics, initialization, the online KD teacher, the tokenizer, chat template and configuration; the training pack is that teacher's

derived_from.rule: each unit is SOB1's depth unit of the same seed with only changed_fields replaced (depth_merge/plan.py compares every other field): SOB1's depth recovery recipe, unchanged

training.recipe: every other field of SOB1's depth unit, compared field by field (`plan.py`): stage stage3_recovery; seeds 20260726 and 20260801 in that order; 9,701 optimizer steps, 3 epochs of 6,467 packed sequences of 8,192 tokens; batch size 2, micro-batch size 1, 2 gradient accumulation steps; fp32 parameters with bf16 autocast and gradient checkpointing; the teacher in bf16 as the online KD teacher; CE 0.25 + KD 1.0, temperature 1.0, assistant scope, Top-200 + tail; AdamW lr 5e-5, weight decay 0.01, betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, clip 1.0; 485 warmup steps, cosine to 0.1; the same trainable patterns (embedding / tied head frozen); cross_context packing (sequential, truncation allowed, standard causal attention); the same pack, tokenizer and save points (every 1,104 steps, keep 1)

after_packing.note: supervised-token exposure is counted from the trainer's log (sum of kd_positions), never derived

training.plans: logs/stages/stage-1/depth_merge/plans/training_plan_depth_merge.json (plan.py, from the committed init record after the build session)

durability.basis: TPI1's 20 save points and finals: uploads 121-161 MB/s; verifying downloads 128-386 MB/s, with an episode of 2.6-4.6 MB/s on the private-repo download path (2026-11-17/18). A 2B save point is 20.9-22.6 GB, so a floor-rate verify takes up to 2.4 h: copies get their time from their bytes, and a session stops training early enough to secure its last save point and the final before its hard deadline
rules: an unreadable relay listing is retried and never read as empty: a unit goes back to step 0 only when a listing that WAS read holds no save point (train_driver.restore_savepoint)
weights uploaded and verified are never sent again: only their record's publication (the handoff) is retried (SavepointMirror.mirror_once, hand_off_with_retries)
a save point is retired only after the next one hands off; save points only after the final hands off

memory.expected: the base's structure and recipe: SOB1's depth units measured 39.38-39.39 GiB peak allocated, 40.90-40.98 GiB peak reserved, 2.90-2.97 GiB least free (REPORT section 3)
memory.first_steps: every unit's trainer logs, for its first `durability.memory_probe_steps` optimizer steps, the peak allocated, peak reserved and the device's free memory after each phase (forward + KD/CE loss, backward, gradient clip, optimizer step: AdamW allocates its state at the first one), and an out-of-memory error with the phase it was raised in (aadistill.training.train.MEMORY_PROBE_ENV; execution only, never in the config hash); the driver keeps them in units.json :: memory
on_oom: in the forward / KD phase: PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, then a smaller loss.kd_chunk (512 -> 256; the same reduction in smaller row chunks), recorded as a deviation
in the optimizer step: PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, then AdamW without the multi-tensor (foreach) temporaries, recorded as a deviation
never: a shorter sequence, another attention, another effective batch size
an 80 GB card only for the affected arm, after these fail on a measured OOM, as a proposal to the maintainer (AGENTS.md P8.2)

evaluation.set: eval-set-1 (development-exposed: no result here is a never-seen blind one)
evaluation.every_item: every item of every unit, in both modes, for every model evaluated

context.rule: every model here -- each untrained arm, the teacher, each recovered arm -- generates until EOS or 8,192 tokens minus its rendered prompt, passed explicitly to both runners (--trained-context 8192): the recovered students' trained context, and the same value for the other two so the three are read under one context (maintainer 2026-11-19)

package.what: the model's weights and config linked, the teacher's tokenizer files and generation config copied and hashed against teacher_identity.json -- one rule for every model evaluated (common.package), as RI-S1 packaged its groups

protocol.resume: each finished sample is streamed and sealed (reasoning_inheritance.driver.fluid / capability with this protocol passed in): a later attempt generates only the samples without a sealed record, each under the seed its item derives; nothing is generated twice and nothing is chosen by outcome
protocol.think_state_rule: the think state every rendered prompt of the mode carries, as the A-MIX plan's evaluations declare it (training_plan.json :: evaluations[].think_state): thinking self_opening, non-thinking preclosed; checked record by record (completion.py)

models.post_recovery: each of depth_merge's two seeds after recovery

evaluation.untrained: not evaluated on eval-set-1: SOB1 found every untrained arm at 0/570 in both modes; the build's state evaluation is the diagnostic

primary_items.rule: fluid_reasoning_720/dev_v1 minus the set's formal-core exclusions (eval_set_scoring.unit_masks) minus the interactive episodes; sha256 over the sorted task ids each followed by a newline

units_of_independence.rule: an item and its other-seed copy are never two independent observations: a group holds its items under both seeds

analysis.comparison: comparison 1 of the round (configs/stages/stage-6/depth_recurrence/design.json :: analysis owns the round's registered plan): depth_merge - depth_only (SOB1), thinking mode primary
analysis.statistic: per pair (X, Y): delta = (1 / (2 x 570)) sum_seeds sum_items (y_X - y_Y); per group g, d_g sums both seeds' differences of the group's items, n_g = 2 |g|
analysis.test: per pair, TPI1's two-sided group-level paired sign-flip test, B = 100,000, numpy default_rng(20261119)
analysis.effect_interval: per pair, the percentile 95% group-bootstrap interval of sum d / sum n, 10,000 resamples, default_rng(20261120); reported beside the test, not the decision

phase_2_finals._placement: the two fp32 finals stay at their relay prefix (the dev box has 23 GiB free and is shared): their next consumer is variant 2 if the selection rule chooses this initialization's path -- variant 2 trains from the TRAINING-PRE initialization, never from these finals, so the finals are the control's weights only

fold_equivalence.what: every merged span's block with its gains folded, alone, against the unmodified block

checks.rule: RI-LM1's: float32 copies of the bf16 teacher blocks on every position of the first packed sequence; error ||y' - y||_F / ||y - x||_F; a non-finite error or one above the tolerance is a defect of the mechanism and stops the build before the candidate is saved
checks.base: the base rebuilt from the teacher (frozen_mapping.keep_blocks on the kept blocks) is compared tensor by tensor with depth_init_tensor_digests.json before any merge; the candidate's tensors outside the 9 merged blocks must equal them and every merged block must differ
checks.config: the candidate's config.json file equals the base's file (sha256 191c51bb...), compared file with file (RI-LM1's attempt-1 lesson: identify_checkpoint's config_sha256 is the parsed config, not the file)

diagnostics.residual_updates: for each merged span on the statistics positions: the teacher span's attention, FFN and whole residual update against the kept block's (the base) and the merged block's on the span's teacher input: norms, ratio, cosine, normalized error (layer_merge.UpdateMoments; RI-LM1's diagnostics)
diagnostics.state_evaluation: the merged initialization against the teacher on the state evaluation suite, beside the base's recorded 3.47 equal-domain KL
diagnostics.role: diagnostic only: nothing selects, gates or drops a run
